value.answer: Mostly, yes. For most healthy adults, melatonin is considered fairly safe for short-term use at low doses, and the common side effects are grogginess the next morning, headaches, vivid dreams, or an upset stomach. Check with a doctor or pharmacist first if you're pregnant or breastfeeding, take blood thinners, diabetes meds, or anything for seizures, mood, or the immune system, or have a health condition. Also, supplement strength varies a lot between brands, so start with the lowest dose and don't assume more works better.
